mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT tn.task_id FROM flow_task_node tn INNER JOIN flow_task t ON tn.task_id = t.id WHERE tn.handler_user_id = #{handlerUserId} AND t.status IN (1, 2) GROUP BY tn.task_id ) sub

SELECT tn.id AS task_node_id, tn.node_id, tn.node_name, tn.sort_num, tn.node_type, tn.handler_user_id, tn.submit_status, tn.handle_time, tn.next_handler_user_id, tn.form_record_id, tn.action, tn.reject_reason, tn.pass_comment, u.real_name AS handler_name, u2.real_name AS next_handler_name FROM flow_task_node tn LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON tn.handler_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON tn.next_handler_user_id = u2.id WHERE tn.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY tn.sort_num ASC
